externalRealVisualGuideline.principle: Use a small number of purposeful real/official visuals. For branded stories, a real local official logo/wordmark/UI asset is preferred over a generic substitute when it is available and reviewed.

LOCAL_OFFICIAL_MEDIA.notes: This provider never downloads a brand asset. A human/authorized local workflow first places the exact official file under the reel's 02-bilder folder and records the official source URL plus usage review note. Resolution only validates/copies the local file into public/reel-assets/<compositionId>/ and binds SHA256. OFFICIAL_SOURCE_REFERENCE is provenance metadata, not a blanket legal permission.

WIKIMEDIA_COMMONS.notes: Use the discovery scout first for documentary/proof candidates. Search and file metadata come from Wikimedia Commons. Production candidates are license-filtered and deterministically ranked by relevance, resolution, crop suitability and rights status before local download. The exact file page must still be reviewed for attribution and non-copyright restrictions such as personality/privacy/trademark concerns where relevant.

GITHUB_RAW.notes: No repository-wide license guessing. The manifest must explicitly pin the commit and license evidence.
